description: Apply source-preserving edits to a parsed model and return the edited notation (the ApplyEdits RPC): set a value, rename with every reference, add a member, import, documentation, comment, connection, transition, satisfy or metadata, delete, move. Edits are located from the parsed spans, so comments and layout outside them are kept, and the result is re-parsed and validated before it is answered; a refused batch answers `error` and `failure` naming why, and nothing is applied. Nothing is written to disk: the edited text comes back as `content` (one document) or `documents` for the agent to write. The result is the ApplyEditsResponse as protojson writes it.

acceptDocuments.description: read the edited documents from the documents field, which a model of several documents needs; without it such a model is refused

document.description: the document whose declarations the operations target, named as the parse named it; empty is the model's first document

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

operations.description: edits to apply, all or none, each a protojson EditOperation with one arm: {"setValue":{"target":qualified name,"value":expression text}}, {"rename":{"target":..,"newName":..}}, {"addMember":{"owner":..,"kind":"part","name":..,...}}, {"delete":{"target":..}}, {"move":..}, {"addConnection":..}, {"addSatisfy":..}, {"addRequirementConstraint":..}, {"addTransition":..}, {"addImport":..}, {"addDocumentation":..}, {"addVerify":..}, {"addMetadata":..}, {"addMetadataPrefix":..}, {"addSequence":..}, {"addComment":..}, {"addNote":..}; see api/proto/sysml.proto for each arm's fields

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: apply_edits
